name: xyz.madcheck/mad-check
title: Mad Check
description: Pre-payment verification for agents: signing firewall, ERC-8004 grades, Born Graded seals.

tools.name: mad_test
tools.description: THE MAD TEST: run the free five-station battery on an ERC-8004 agent (Base): its grade with evidence, the grader graded by the same machine, the F-01 ten-year-window trap caught by the signing firewall, the registry census, and a witness receipt hash. Run it on yourself first.

url.description: Optional: one of the agent's endpoints to add as a sixth station

tools.name: mad_check_agent
tools.description: Grade an ERC-8004 registration on Base before paying its owner: LIVE / DEAD END / GHOST / MALFORMED with evidence (owner, card, services, endpoint probes). ERROR means the check itself could not complete — it is not a grade.

tools.name: mad_check_authorization
tools.description: Signing firewall for EIP-3009 / x402 authorizations. Call BEFORE signing, every time. Returns SIGN or DONT_SIGN with machine-readable reasons. A DONT_SIGN is a stop, not a suggestion; a SIGN is evidence, not an instruction — the caller's own policy still decides.

value.description: Amount in the token's smallest unit, as a string

now.description: Optional: pin evaluation time, unix seconds

tools.name: mad_check_endpoint
tools.description: Check an endpoint before paying against its printed x402 price: HTTP status, latency, sha256 of the body served, and whether it is alive at all. A dead door's price print is a price for nothing.

tools.name: mad_seal_lookup
tools.description: Born Graded seal lookup: before buying a newly launched token, get its seal state — SEALED (claim sheet filed, anchored, graded against the contracts), UNSEALED (no graded sheet backs it), or FAILED (graded and contradicted). UNSEALED or FAILED on a new launch means walk.

address.description: Token contract address (exact address, never a ticker)

tools.name: mad_witness_head
tools.description: Read the head of MAD's signed, hash-chained witness ledger (latest seq + head hash + signer). Entries are readable individually at GET /v1/witness/{seq} on the API.
